path_step: User navigates to the calendar page when no sessions are scheduled for their enrolled courses.
test_scenario: Verify that the calendar page correctly displays as empty when the user has no scheduled sessions for any of their enrolled courses.
test_case_title: Display Empty Calendar for User with No Scheduled Sessions
pre_condition: A user (Student or Teacher) is logged in and enrolled in at least one course, but there are no sessions scheduled for any of their enrolled courses.
expected_result: The calendar is displayed, but it appears empty, indicating no scheduled sessions. The system should clearly convey that no sessions are planned.
post_condition: The user successfully views an empty calendar page.

test_steps.step: Log in as a user who is enrolled in at least one course but has no sessions scheduled for any of their enrolled courses.
Navigate to the 'Calendar' page from the Dashboard.
Verify that the calendar is displayed and clearly shows no scheduled sessions (e.g., an empty calendar view, a 'No Sessions' message).
